# Giant Ancestry: Storm's Thunder (`traits:giant-ancestry-storms-thunder`)
**Species:** [Goliath](../species/goliath.md) | **Subspecies:** [Giant Ancestry: Storm's Thunder](../subspecies/giant-ancestry-storms-thunder.md)

When you take damage from a creature within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to deal 1d8 Thunder damage to that creature.
